                    <span style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700;">Career Goals Archetype</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sample-answer-body">
                    <p style="font-style: italic; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 0.9rem;">
                        <strong>Candidate Background:</strong> Senior Software Engineer at a Tier-1 Fintech firm aiming
                        for a post-MBA Product Management (PM) role in digital lending.
                    </p>

                    <div class="framework-steps">
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label situation">Context & Trajectory</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “Over the last 4 years at PayGlobal, I architected the core loan disbursement engine
                                that currently processes $45M in monthly micro-loans across Southeast Asia. While I
                                mastered technical scalability and API latency, I discovered that my real passion lies
                                at the intersection of customer journey design, unit economics, and credit risk models.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label task">The Skill Gap</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “To transition from building technical specs to owning product strategy and P&L as a
                                Senior Product Manager at firms like Razorpay, PhonePe, or CRED, I have two critical
                                knowledge gaps: structured corporate finance (managing credit loss provisions) and
                                go-to-market strategy.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label action">Why ISB Specifically</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “ISB’s 1-year PGP is uniquely calibrated for my inflection point. Specifically, I plan
                                to leverage Professor Bhagwan Chowdhry’s <em>Fintech & Financial Inclusion</em>
                                elective, participate in the <em>Experiential Learning Programme (ELP)</em> with a
                                digital lending partner, and lead the Business Technology Club to organize the annual
                                Product Conclave.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label result">Long-Term Vision & Plan B</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “Long-term (7–10 years), I aspire to lead digital banking products for underbanked MSMEs
                                across Bharat. If fintech PM hiring contracts during my cycle, my Plan B is Strategy
                                Consulting in the Digital Financial Services practice, which offers parallel
                                problem-solving rigor.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="adcom-lens-callout">
                        <h5>💡 Why This Answer Wins with ISB AdCom</h5>
                        <p>
                            1. It avoids generic statements like “I want an MBA to become a leader.”<br>
                            2. It names specific courses, professors, and clubs at ISB, proving deep institutional research.<br>
                            3. It presents a logical, credible bridge from tech engineering to Fintech PM with an ironclad Plan B.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Sample Answer 2 -->
            <div class="sample-answer-block">
                <div class="sample-answer-header">
                    <h4>Sample Answer 2: “Tell Me About a Time You Resolved a Major Team Conflict”</h4>
                    <span style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700;">Leadership & EQ Archetype</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sample-answer-body">
                    <p style="font-style: italic; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 0.9rem;">
                        <strong>Candidate Background:</strong> Management Consultant leading a cross-border ERP implementation project.
                    </p>

                    <div class="framework-steps">
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label situation">Situation</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “During an 8-month ERP modernization project for a major FMCG client in Dubai, our
                                6-person delivery team was split into two hostile factions: the client’s legacy IT team
                                was resisting data migration due to fears of operational downtime, while our technical
                                architects insisted on an aggressive 48-hour hard cutover.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label task">Task</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “As the Project Lead, the client VP warned me that if we did not establish a unified
                                deployment roadmap within 5 business days, the multi-million-dollar contract would face
                                penalty clauses and delay.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label action">Action</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “Instead of forcing a top-down mandate, I first organized individual 1-on-1 listening
                                sessions over coffee with the legacy IT heads to uncover their unspoken concerns: they
                                feared being held liable if inventory tracking failed during peak sales weekend. I then
                                convened a structured workshop and proposed a phased hybrid cutover: migrating
                                non-critical regional warehouses first on a Wednesday, running parallel reconciliation
                                for 72 hours, and then transitioning headquarters once stability was proven.”
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label result">Result & Learning</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                “Both teams aligned on the compromise. We executed the migration with 0% data loss and
                                zero supply disruption, saving the client an estimated $320,000 in potential retail
                                stockouts. This taught me that leadership in conflict isn’t about proving who is right;
                                it is about addressing psychological fear with structured risk mitigation.”
                            </p>
                        </div>

                            3. Delivered a quantified bottom-line outcome ($320k saved, zero downtime) and a mature self-reflection.
                        </p>

            <!-- Section 5: Mistakes Candidates Make -->
            <div id="mistakes"></div>
            <h2>5. Critical Mistakes Candidates Make in ISB Interviews</h2>
            <p>
                Every year, hundreds of candidates with stellar 720+ GMAT/GRE scores and blue-chip resumes fail the ISB
                interview due to predictable, avoidable missteps. Review the top pitfalls and their proven remedies:
            </p>

            <div class="mistakes-grid">
                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall 01</span>
                    <div class="mistake-title">Surface-Level Industry Knowledge</div>
                    <div class="mistake-desc">
                        Assuming you only need to know your daily coding, auditing, or operational tasks. When asked
                        about company revenues, competitors, EBITDA margins, or industry headwinds, candidates freeze.
                    </div>
                    <div class="mistake-fix">
                        <strong>The Fix:</strong> Memorize your company’s P&L metrics, unit economics, market share, and
                        top 3 competitor strategies before entering the room.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall 02</span>
                    <div class="mistake-title">Unrealistic or Robotic Career Goals</div>
                    <div class="mistake-desc">
                        Claiming you want to pivot from quality assurance directly into Tier-1 Venture Capital or
                        Private Equity without demonstrating the required financial modeling background or intermediary
                        stepping stones.
                    </div>
                    <div class="mistake-fix">
                        <strong>The Fix:</strong> Ground your goals in credible pre-MBA skill transferability. Have a
                        bulletproof explanation for how ISB bridges the exact gap.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall 03</span>
                    <div class="mistake-title">Defensive Reaction to Stress Questions</div>
                    <div class="mistake-desc">
                        When an alumnus pushes back saying, <em>“Your project doesn’t sound very innovative,”</em>
                        nervous candidates become visibly flustered or argumentative.
                    </div>
                    <div class="mistake-fix">
                        <strong>The Fix:</strong> Reframe stress questions as an invitation to elaborate. Stay calm,
                        smile, acknowledge the panellist’s perspective, and calmly present supporting data.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall 04</span>
                    <div class="mistake-title">Ignoring Macro & Current Affairs</div>
                    <div class="mistake-desc">
                        Failing to articulate informed opinions on the Union Budget, RBI rate cycles, global
                        geopolitical realignments, or AI developments relevant to India.
                    </div>
                    <div class="mistake-fix">
                        <strong>The Fix:</strong> Read <em>Mint</em>, <em>The Economic Times</em>, or <em>The Ken</em>
                        daily for 3 weeks prior to your interview. Prepare 3 sector-specific talking points.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

                        <span class="faq-toggle-icon">+</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        The ISB interview typically runs between 25 to 45 minutes. The panel consists of 2 to 3
                        interviewers, primarily composed of accomplished ISB alumni who are senior business leaders in
                        your target domain or functional area, often joined by an Admissions Committee representative.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="faq-item" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">

                        <span>Is the ISB interview conducted blind or non-blind?</span>
                        <span class="faq-toggle-icon">+</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        The ISB interview is strictly <strong>non-blind</strong>. The interviewers have thoroughly
                        analyzed your complete application file—including your essays, resume, Key Result Areas (KRAs),
                        employment history, and recommendation letters. Expect deep, specific follow-up questions
                        probing every claim.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="faq-item" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
                    <div class="faq-question">
                        <span>How important are Current Affairs in the ISB interview?</span>
                        <span class="faq-toggle-icon">+</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        Extremely important. Because the 1-year PGP requires high-speed case discussions in a diverse
                        classroom, panellists regularly ask candidates about macroeconomic policy, Union Budget
                        allocations, central bank interest rates, and tech disruptions impacting their specific
                        industry.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="faq-item" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">

                        <span>What percentage of interviewed candidates receive an offer from ISB?</span>
                        <span class="faq-toggle-icon">+</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        Historically, ISB invites approximately 25–35% of total applicants to interview. Of those
                        interviewed, approximately 40–50% receive an admission offer, making the interview the single
                        most pivotal stage in the admissions funnel.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="faq-item" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
                    <div class="faq-question">
                        <span>Can I request a campus change (Hyderabad vs Mohali) during the interview?</span>
                        <span class="faq-toggle-icon">+</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        No. ISB operates as ‘One School, Two Campuses’ with identical faculty, placement access, and
                        curriculum. Campus allocation is determined by an automated algorithm after admission to
                        maintain balanced class diversity. Focus your interview entirely on your fit for ISB as an
                        institution.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

        </main>

    <!-- Interactive JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Reading Progress Bar & Scroll Events
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const winScroll = document.documentElement.scrollTop || document.body.scrollTop;
            const height = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight;
            const scrolled = (winScroll / height) * 100;
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
            if (progressBar) {
                progressBar.style.width = scrolled + '%';
            }

            // Back to top visibility
            const backBtn = document.getElementById('backToTopBtn');
            if (backBtn) {
                if (winScroll > 350) {
                    backBtn.classList.add('show');
                } else {
                    backBtn.classList.remove('show');
                }
            }

            // Update Active TOC
            updateActiveToc();
        });

        function scrollToTop() {
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Mobile Nav Drawer Toggle
        function toggleMobileDrawer() {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
            drawer.classList.toggle('open');
            document.body.style.overflow = drawer.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
        }

        function closeDrawerOnBackdrop(e) {
            if (e.target === document.getElementById('mobile-drawer')) {
                toggleMobileDrawer();
            }
        }

        // Mobile TOC Dropdown Toggle
        function toggleMobileToc() {
            const card = document.getElementById('mobile-toc-toggle');
            const chevron = document.getElementById('mobile-toc-chevron');
            card.classList.toggle('active');
            chevron.textContent = card.classList.contains('active') ? '▲' : '▼';
        }

        // Active Table of Contents Tracker
        function updateActiveToc() {
            const sections = document.querySelectorAll('main h2, #isb-process, #what-isb-looks-for, #frequently-asked-questions, #sample-answers, #mistakes, #prep-plan, #simulator-section, #lead-magnet, #faq');
            const tocLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.toc-list a');

            let currentSectionId = '';
            sections.forEach(section => {
                const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.top <= 140) {
                    currentSectionId = section.getAttribute('id');
                }
            });

            if (currentSectionId) {
                tocLinks.forEach(link => {
                    link.classList.remove('active');
                    if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + currentSectionId) {
                        link.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Filter Categorized Questions
        function filterQuestions(category, btnElement) {
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.q-filter-btn');
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            if (btnElement) {
                btnElement.classList.add('active');
            }

            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.q-card-item');
            items.forEach(item => {
                if (category === 'all' || item.getAttribute('data-category') === category) {
                    item.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    item.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

        // FAQ Accordion Toggle
        function toggleFaq(element) {
            const isActive = element.classList.contains('active');
            document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
            if (!isActive) {
                element.classList.add('active');
            }
        }

        // AI Simulator Industry Question Switcher
        const simQuestionsMap = {
            tech: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"Why do you need an MBA at ISB right now, and why not stay in tech?\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"How will recent AI innovations impact unit economics in your firm?\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"Tell me about a time you had to lead a project without formal authority.\"" }
            ],
            consulting: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"Why do you want to switch to post-MBA strategy consulting from your current domain?\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"Describe a time a senior client vehemently rejected your analytical model.\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"How would you evaluate an M&A target in the Indian retail grocery market?\"" }
            ],
            finance: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"Walk me through how the latest RBI repo rate decision impacts your portfolio margins.\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"If you had ₹100 Crores to invest in one Indian sector over the next 5 years, where would you deploy it?\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"Tell me about a financial deal or risk model where your assumption was proven wrong.\"" }
            ],
            ops: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"How are global supply chain realignments ('China+1') impacting your factory's CAPEX?\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"Explain a process optimization you led that directly improved EBITDA margins.\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"What is the biggest operational bottleneck preventing Indian manufacturing from scaling?\"" }
            ],
            startup: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"What is your true Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) vs Lifetime Value (LTV), and why do you need ISB?\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"Tell me about a painful pivot you executed based on user churn data.\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"How do you plan to scale your family business into a pan-India corporate brand?\"" }
            ],
            marketing: [
                { val: "q1", text: "\"How do you measure marketing attribution and ROI in high-CAC digital campaigns?\"" },
                { val: "q2", text: "\"Tell me about a product launch that failed to hit its target sales volume and why.\"" },
                { val: "q3", text: "\"Pick an FMCG brand that executed a brilliant brand turnaround in India recently.\"" }
            ]
        };

        function updateSimQuestions() {
            const industry = document.getElementById('sim-industry').value;
            const selectBox = document.getElementById('sim-question-select');
            selectBox.innerHTML = '';

            const list = simQuestionsMap[industry] || simQuestionsMap['tech'];
            list.forEach(item => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = item.val;
                opt.textContent = item.text;
                selectBox.appendChild(opt);
            });
        }

        // Run AI Simulator Analysis
        function analyzeSimAnswer() {
            const answer = document.getElementById('sim-user-answer').value.trim();
            const resultsBox = document.getElementById('sim-results');

            if (!answer) {
                alert("Please enter a short draft answer to receive simulated ISB AdCom feedback.");
                return;
            }

            const length = answer.length;
            const structure = Math.min(96, Math.max(78, Math.floor(76 + (length / 22))));
            const leadership = Math.min(95, Math.max(80, Math.floor(82 + (Math.random() * 12))));
            const business = Math.min(94, Math.max(75, Math.floor(80 + (Math.random() * 14))));
            const clarity = Math.min(96, Math.max(82, Math.floor(84 + (Math.random() * 10))));

            document.getElementById('score-structure').textContent = structure + '%';
            document.getElementById('score-leadership').textContent = leadership + '%';
            document.getElementById('score-business').textContent = business + '%';
            document.getElementById('score-clarity').textContent = clarity + '%';

            resultsBox.style.display = 'block';
            resultsBox.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        }

        // Lead Magnet Forms & Modal Controls
        function openDownloadModal() {
            document.getElementById('download-modal').style.display = 'flex';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }

        function closeDownloadModal() {
            document.getElementById('download-modal').style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }

        function closeModalOnBackdrop(event) {
            if (event.target === document.getElementById('download-modal')) {
                closeDownloadModal();
            }
        }

        function handleLeadSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const email = document.getElementById('lead-email').value;
            if (email) {
                alert("🎉 Thank you! The 2026-2027 ISB Interview Question Bank PDF has been dispatched to: " + email);
                document.getElementById('lead-magnet-form').reset();
            }
        }

        function handleModalSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const email = document.getElementById('modal-email-input').value;
            if (email) {
                document.getElementById('modal-form-content').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('modal-success').style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

        .pill-strategy { background: #E0F2FE; color: #0369A1; }
        .pill-fit { background: #FDF2F4; color: var(--primary); }
        .pill-wildcard { background: #F3E8FF; color: #7E22CE; }

        .q-title {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .q-insight {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: #475569;
            background: #F8FAFC;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
            margin-top: 10px;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .q-insight strong {
            color: var(--primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* Sample Answers Breakdown Section */
        .sample-answer-block {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            margin: 28px 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .sample-answer-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E293B, #0F172A);
            color: #FFFFFF;
            padding: 18px 22px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .sample-answer-header h4 {
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin: 0;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .sample-answer-body {
            padding: 22px;
        }

        .framework-steps {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }

        .step-row {
            background: #F8FAFC;
            border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 14px 16px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .step-label {
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .step-label.context { color: #2563EB; }
        .step-label.action { color: #059669; }
        .step-label.impact { color: #D97706; }
        .step-label.reflection { color: var(--primary); }

        .step-text {
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            color: #334155;
            line-height: 1.65;
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .adcom-lens-callout {
            background: #FDF2F4;
            border: 1px solid #FECDD3;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 16px 18px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .adcom-lens-callout h5 {
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .adcom-lens-callout p {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: #4C0519;
            margin: 0;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        /* Common Mistakes Comparison Cards */
        .mistakes-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 26px 0;
        }

        .mistake-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 18px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .mistake-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .mistake-tag {
            background: #FEE2E2;
            color: #DC2626;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mistake-title {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .mistake-desc {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: #64748B;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .mistake-fix {
            background: #F0FDF4;
            border-left: 3px solid #10B981;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: #065F46;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* Real Interview Experiences Tabbed Debriefs */
        .debriefs-wrapper {
            background: #F8FAFC;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 22px;
            margin: 30px 0;
        }

        .debrief-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            scrollbar-width: thin;
        }

        .debrief-tab-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .debrief-tab-btn.active, .debrief-tab-btn:hover {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .debrief-content-pane {
            display: none;
        }

        .debrief-content-pane.active {
            display: block;
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-in-out;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .candidate-profile-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .badge-admitted {
            background: #DCFCE7;
            color: #15803D;
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .debrief-quote {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
            padding: 14px 16px;
            border-radius: 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0;
            margin: 14px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: #334155;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Practice Effectively Protocol */
        .protocol-steps-list {
            margin: 24px 0;
            list-style: none !important;
            counter-reset: step-counter;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .protocol-step {
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 54px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
        }

        .protocol-step::before {
            counter-increment: step-counter;
            content: counter(step-counter);
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(165, 28, 48, 0.3);
        }

        .protocol-step h4 {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-weight: 700;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .protocol-step p {
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            color: #475569;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Interactive AI HBS Simulator Widget */
        .ai-simulator-widget {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E1B4B 100%);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            padding: 32px 24px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
            margin: 40px 0;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3);
        }

        .ai-widget-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .ai-widget-badge {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6366F1, #EC4899);
            color: white;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .ai-widget-title {
            font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.5vw, 1.6rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: white;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .ai-widget-subtitle {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #94A3B8;
            max-width: 650px;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .ai-simulator-app {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 20px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .sim-input-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .sim-label {
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #CBD5E1;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            display: block;
        }

        .sim-select, .sim-textarea {
            width: 100%;
            background: #1E293B;
            border: 1px solid #334155;
            color: #F8FAFC;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-family: inherit;
            outline: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .sim-select:focus, .sim-textarea:focus {
            border-color: #818CF8;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.25);
        }

        .sim-textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 100px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .sim-btn-submit {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366F1, #4F46E5);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
            width: auto;
        }

        .sim-btn-submit:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4F46E5, #3730A3);
        }

        .sim-result-box {
            display: none;
            background: #1E293B;
            border: 1px solid #475569;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 18px;
            margin-top: 18px;
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        .sim-score-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 14px 0;
        }

        .score-pill {
            background: #0F172A;
            border: 1px solid #334155;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 10px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .score-pill .score-val {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #38BDF8;
        }

        .score-pill .score-lbl {
            font-size: 0.68rem;
            color: #94A3B8;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        /* Lead Magnet Callout Card */
        .lead-magnet-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FDF2F4 0%, #FFF1F2 100%);
            border: 2px solid #FECDD3;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            padding: 32px 24px;
            margin: 40px 0;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(165, 28, 48, 0.08);
        }

        .lead-magnet-badge {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        .lead-magnet-title {
            font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.5vw, 1.7rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #881337;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            line-height: 1.3;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .lead-magnet-desc {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: #4C0519;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .lead-features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
        }

        .lead-feature-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: #4C0519;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .lead-feature-item svg {
            color: var(--primary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .lead-form-box {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            padding: 16px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1px solid #FDA4AF;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .lead-form-inline {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .lead-form-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            font-family: inherit;
            outline: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .lead-form-input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-glow);
        }

        .lead-form-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 22px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            white-space: nowrap;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(165, 28, 48, 0.3);
        }

        .lead-form-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(165, 28, 48, 0.4);
        }

        /* FAQ Accordion Section */
        .faq-accordion {
            margin: 28px 0;
        }

        .faq-item {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .faq-item:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .faq-question {
            padding: 16px 20px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            user-select: none;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .faq-toggle-icon {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--primary);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .faq-item.active .faq-toggle-icon {
            transform: rotate(45deg);
        }

        .faq-answer {
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: max-height 0.35s ease-out, padding 0.3s ease;
            background: #F8FAFC;
            color: #475569;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            line-height: 1.65;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }

        .faq-item.active .faq-answer {
            max-height: 400px;
            padding: 14px 20px 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        /* Sidebar Styling */
        .sidebar {
            position: relative;
        }

        .sidebar-sticky-wrap {
            position: sticky;
            top: 85px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 22px;
        }

        .sidebar-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 22px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .sidebar-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1.5px solid #F1F5F9;
        }

        .toc-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .toc-list li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .toc-list a {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            display: block;
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .toc-list a:hover, .toc-list a.active {
            color: var(--primary);
            background: var(--primary-light);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding-left: 10px;
        }

        /* Sidebar Lead Magnet Box */
        .sidebar-download-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E1B4B 0%, #31101E 100%);
            color: white;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 22px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }

        .sidebar-download-box h4 {
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .sidebar-download-box p {
            color: #CBD5E1;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .btn-sidebar-download {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B, #D97706);
            color: #0F172A;
            border: none;
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-decoration: none;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 100%;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .btn-sidebar-download:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
        }

        /* Sidebar Free Eval CTA */
        .sidebar-consult-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .sidebar-consult-card .stars {
            color: #F59E0B;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .sidebar-consult-card h4 {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            color: var(--dark-navy);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .sidebar-consult-card p {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .btn-eval-cta {
            background: var(--dark-navy);
            color: white;
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 100%;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .btn-eval-cta:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        /* Footer */
        .site-footer {
            background: #0F172A;
            color: #94A3B8;
            padding: 50px 20px 24px;
            border-top: 1px solid #1E293B;
            font-size: 0.88rem;
        }

        .footer-grid {
            max-width: 1240px;
            margin: 0 auto 36px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .footer-col h5 {
            color: white;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .footer-col ul {
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .footer-col li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .footer-col a {
            color: #94A3B8;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .footer-col a:hover {
            color: white;
        }

        .footer-bottom {
            max-width: 1240px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid #1E293B;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #64748B;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Download Modal */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
            z-index: 99999;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .modal-card {
            background: white;
            max-width: 480px;
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            padding: 30px 24px;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            position: relative;
            animation: modalPop 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        @keyframes modalPop {
            from { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0; }
            to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
        }

        .modal-close-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 16px;
            right: 16px;
            background: #F1F5F9;
            border: none;
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #64748B;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .modal-close-btn:hover {
            background: #E2E8F0;
            color: #0F172A;
        }

        .modal-success-state {
            display: none;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 16px 0;
        }

        .success-icon {
            width: 54px;
            height: 54px;
            background: #DCFCE7;
            color: #16A34A;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;

            <!-- Section 1: Harvard MBA Interview Overview -->
            <h2>1. Harvard MBA Interview Overview</h2>
            <p>
                The Harvard Business School admissions process culminates in one of the most intense, intellectually rigorous interviews in graduate education. Unlike corporate recruiting or peer business schools where alumni conduct open-ended, behavioral chats, HBS entrusts interviews strictly to professional members of its <strong>Admissions Board</strong>.
            </p>
            <p>
                The purpose of the interview is not to confirm the achievements already verified in your application. Instead, it serves as a live simulation of the <strong>HBS Case Method</strong>. The board seeks to answer one fundamental question:
            </p>
            <blockquote style="background: #FDF2F4; border-left: 4px solid var(--primary); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; margin: 20px 0; font-weight: 600; color: #881337; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.65;">
                “Can this candidate think dynamically on their feet, defend their logic under pressure, teach 90 world-class peers in Aldrich Hall, and exhibit a habitual impulse for leadership?”
            </blockquote>
            <p>
                Around 9,500 to 10,000 candidates apply to HBS annually. Approximately 1,800 to 2,000 are invited to interview, and roughly 900 to 1,000 are ultimately offered admission. This means that walking into the interview gives you roughly a <strong>50% statistical probability</strong> of acceptance—making preparation the decisive lever between a matriculation letter and a heartbreak.
            </p>

            <!-- Section 2: Interview Format -->
            <div id="format"></div>
            <h2>2. The Harvard MBA Interview Format</h2>
            <p>
                Understanding the operational format of the HBS interview is essential to avoid being disoriented by its rapid pace. Here are the core characteristics that define every HBS interview:
            </p>

            <div class="format-features-grid">
                <div class="format-box">
                    <div class="format-box-icon">⏱️</div>
                    <h4>Strict 30-Minute Hard Stop</h4>
                    <p>The interview is synchronized to the second. There is zero small talk or introductory preamble. The interviewer jumps directly into your first substantive work project or undergraduate decision.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="format-box">
                    <div class="format-box-icon">👥</div>
                    <h4>The Lead & Silent Observer Duo</h4>
                    <p>You will usually face two AdCom members. One acts as the conversational lead, while the second remains silent, carefully capturing non-verbal cues, analytical rigor, and clarity of thought.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="format-box">
                    <div class="format-box-icon">🎯</div>
                    <h4>Hyper-Customized & Non-Blind</h4>
                    <p>The interviewers have thoroughly analyzed your transcript, resume bullets, and recommendations. You will never hear "Tell me about yourself." Instead: "Why did your firm choose an EBITDA multiple approach on Project Falcon?"</p>
                </div>
                <div class="format-box">
                    <div class="format-box-icon">📝</div>
                    <h4>The 24-Hour Written Reflection</h4>
                    <p>Within 24 hours of concluding your interview, you must submit a 300–450 word written reflection through the HBS portal. It serves as your closing statement and self-critique.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Section 3: What Harvard Evaluates -->
            <div id="evaluates"></div>
            <h2>3. What Harvard Evaluates: The 3 Core Pillars</h2>
            <p>
                HBS does not look for a generic "checklist" candidate. Their evaluation framework is rooted in three non-negotiable criteria published in their official admissions criteria. Every question you receive maps directly back to one of these dimensions:
            </p>

            <div class="pillars-wrapper">
                <div class="pillar-card">
                    <div class="pillar-num">Pillar 01</div>
                    <div class="pillar-title">Habit of Leadership</div>
                    <div class="pillar-desc">
                        Leadership at HBS isn’t about titles or seniority; it’s an everyday habit of initiative, impact, and rallying others behind meaningful change.
                    </div>
                    <ul class="pillar-check-list">
                        <li>Did you create impact beyond your direct job description?</li>
                        <li>How do you handle interpersonal conflict or dissent?</li>
                        <li>Can you inspire cross-functional teams without formal authority?</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pillar-card">
                    <div class="pillar-num">Pillar 02</div>
                    <div class="pillar-title">Analytical Aptitude & Appetite</div>
                    <div class="pillar-desc">
                        The case method demands rapid synthesis of messy data. AdCom assesses whether you possess intellectual curiosity and structured problem-solving instincts.
                    </div>
                    <ul class="pillar-check-list">
                        <li>Do you understand the macro & micro-economics of your sector?</li>
                        <li>Can you articulate unit economics and business models on the fly?</li>
                        <li>Do you acknowledge uncertainty with intellectual honesty?</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pillar-card">
                    <div class="pillar-num">Pillar 03</div>
                    <div class="pillar-title">Engaged Community Citizenship</div>
                    <div class="pillar-desc">
                        Aldrich Hall thrives on diverse viewpoints delivered with empathy, high emotional intelligence, and respect for divergent perspectives.
                    </div>
                    <ul class="pillar-check-list">
                        <li>Do you listen actively before defending your thesis?</li>
                        <li>How will you contribute to section culture outside the classroom?</li>
                        <li>Do you demonstrate authentic humility and self-awareness?</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Section 4: Top 25 Harvard MBA Interview Questions -->
            <div id="top-25-questions"></div>
            <h2>4. Top 25 Harvard MBA Interview Questions</h2>
            <p>
                While HBS interviews are notoriously bespoke, questions fall into five distinct tactical clusters. Use the interactive filter below to explore the 25 most frequent Harvard MBA interview questions along with the hidden intent of the Admissions Board.
            </p>

            <!-- Interactive Questions Explorer -->
            <div class="q-explorer-box">
                <div class="q-filter-tabs">
                    <button class="q-filter-btn active" onclick="filterQuestions('all', this)">All (25)</button>
                    <button class="q-filter-btn" onclick="filterQuestions('resume', this)">Career & Resume</button>
                    <button class="q-filter-btn" onclick="filterQuestions('leadership', this)">Leadership & Conflict</button>
                    <button class="q-filter-btn" onclick="filterQuestions('strategy', this)">Industry & Strategy</button>
                    <button class="q-filter-btn" onclick="filterQuestions('fit', this)">Goals & HBS Fit</button>
                    <button class="q-filter-btn" onclick="filterQuestions('wildcard', this)">Wildcard & Reflection</button>
                </div>

                <div id="questions-list">

                    <!-- Resume / Career Questions -->
                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="resume">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q01</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-resume">Career & Resume</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Walk me through the decision-making process when you transitioned from Company A to Company B."</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">They aren't asking for your job responsibilities; they want to assess intentionality, risk-tolerance, and whether your career moves were proactive or reactive.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Tests career agency, strategic planning, and whether you run <em>toward</em> growth opportunities rather than running <em>away</em> from friction.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="resume">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q02</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-resume">Career & Resume</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Looking back at your undergraduate major, why did you choose it, and what would you change today?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Evaluates your retrospective self-awareness and how your intellectual interests have evolved over time.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Tests self-reflection and whether you take intellectual risks or merely follow standard paths of least resistance.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="resume">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q03</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-resume">Career & Resume</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Explain the most complex deal/product launch on your resume as if I were a first-time angel investor."</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Assesses your ability to distill technical jargon into executive-level strategic communication.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Case-method simulation: Can you communicate clearly without hiding behind domain buzzwords?</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="resume">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q04</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-resume">Career & Resume</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"What was the single most surprising finding during your latest project at work?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Probes whether you operate with genuine curiosity or simply execute predetermined playbook tasks.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Evaluates your analytical appetite for counter-intuitive insights and data anomalies.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="resume">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q05</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-resume">Career & Resume</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Who is the best leader you've worked under, and what specific habits did you adopt from them?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Uncovers your mentorship radar, humility, and willingness to learn from senior colleagues.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Measures observational EQ and your ability to internalize management best practices.</div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Leadership & Conflict Questions -->
                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="leadership">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q06</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Conflict</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Tell me about a time you had to push back on a direct mandate from a partner or VP."</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Tests your moral courage, diplomacy, and analytical foundation when disagreeing with power.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Checks if you have the backbone to speak truth to power in a constructive, data-backed manner.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="leadership">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q07</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Conflict</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Describe a situation where a teammate was underperforming. How did you handle it?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Looks at empathy vs. accountability in peer-to-peer relationships.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Shows whether you coach and elevate peers or complain and take over their work.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="leadership">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q08</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Conflict</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"What is the toughest piece of critical feedback you've ever received, and how did you adjust?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">A direct test of coachability and defensive tendencies.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Red flag check: Arrogant candidates deflect blame; winning candidates show vulnerability and measurable behavioral change.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="leadership">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q09</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Conflict</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="q-title">"Give an example of a time you failed to convince a stakeholder. What would you do differently today?"</div>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 0;">Probes your resilience, stakeholder management, and post-mortem analysis skills.</p>
                        <div class="q-insight"><strong>AdCom Intent:</strong> Assesses your capacity for honest self-critique without making excuses.</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="q-card-item" data-category="leadership">
                        <div class="q-card-header">
                            <span class="q-index-tag">Q10</span>
                            <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Conflict</span>

            <h2>5. Winning Sample Answers & Frameworks</h2>
            <p>
                At HBS, the standard STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) model is often too mechanical and linear. Top admitted candidates use the <strong>CARL Framework</strong> (Context & Stakes, Action & Nuance, Result & Quantification, Lessons & Self-Reflection), followed by an immediate macro connection to enterprise strategy.
            </p>

            <!-- Sample Answer 1 -->
            <div class="sample-answer-block">
                <div class="sample-answer-header">
                    <h4>Sample 01: "Tell me about a time you pushed back on leadership."</h4>
                    <span class="q-category-pill pill-leadership">Leadership & Pushback</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sample-answer-body">
                    <div class="framework-steps">
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label context">Context & Stakes</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "In late 2024, our firm was preparing to sign a $40M term sheet for a B2B SaaS logistics acquisition. Our managing director was bullish on the target's 65% ARR growth, but my cohort was tasked with evaluating customer retention data."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label action">Action & Tact</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "When analyzing net revenue retention by vintage cohort, I noticed gross churn among top-tier enterprise accounts had accelerated by 22% over the last two quarters, masked by heavy discounting on low-margin pilot contracts. Instead of raising alarms in a full committee meeting, I booked a 15-minute 1-on-1 with the deal lead. I walked him through the cohort decay charts and proposed an earn-out restructuring clause rather than killing the deal outright."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label impact">Result & Quantification</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "The partner endorsed the restructuring. We renegotiated the valuation downward by $6M and tied 30% of the purchase price to 18-month enterprise renewal milestones, shielding our LP fund from severe downside risk."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label reflection">Reflection & HBS Takeaway</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "The key lesson was that effective pushback isn't about proving someone wrong; it’s about providing leadership with structured optionality and mitigating enterprise risk while respecting their strategic thesis."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="adcom-lens-callout">
                        <h5>🏛️ Why This Answer Wins with HBS AdCom:</h5>
                        <p>The candidate avoids emotional drama, demonstrates deep analytical mastery of SaaS metrics (gross churn vs. net expansion), demonstrates high EQ diplomacy by consulting 1-on-1 first, and delivers a constructive solution (earn-out) rather than a simple veto.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Sample Answer 2 -->
            <div class="sample-answer-block">
                <div class="sample-answer-header">
                    <h4>Sample 02: "If you were CEO of your firm, what is the biggest change you'd make?"</h4>
                    <span class="q-category-pill pill-strategy">Strategic Vision</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sample-answer-body">
                    <div class="framework-steps">
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label context">Strategic Diagnosis</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "Today, our enterprise software business generates 75% of its free cash flow from our on-prem legacy ERP tools. While that provides solid dividend stability, our cloud ARR is growing at just 12% year-over-year, lagging specialized cloud competitors who are growing at 35%."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label action">Two-Pillar Execution Plan</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "As CEO, I would execute two decisive shifts: First, pivot our R&D capital allocation by reallocating 40% of maintenance engineering spend into API-first middleware integrations. Second, revamp our sales commission structure from upfront contract booking value to consumption-based net retention incentives to align sales reps with long-term customer adoption."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="step-row">
                            <span class="step-label impact">Anticipated Trade-Offs & Friction</span>
                            <p class="step-text">
                                "This would compress operating margins by roughly 300 basis points over the first 18 months, which public markets might penalize initially. However, it preserves our terminal enterprise value before legacy churn becomes irreversible by 2028."
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="adcom-lens-callout">
                        <h5>🏛️ Why This Answer Wins with HBS AdCom:</h5>
                        <p>The response proves executive-level thinking. It doesn't just suggest a fun idea; it addresses resource reallocation, sales compensation, and transparently acknowledges the financial trade-off (margin compression) that a real CEO must navigate with Wall Street.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Section 6: Common Mistakes -->
            <div id="mistakes"></div>
            <h2>6. Fatal Mistakes Candidates Make in HBS Interviews</h2>
            <p>
                Because HBS interviewers are trained psychologists and admissions veterans, they can spot scripted performances within 90 seconds. Here are the six most common pitfalls that sink otherwise brilliant candidates:
            </p>

            <div class="mistakes-grid">
                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #1</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Robotic, Over-Rehearsed Soundbites</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Reciting memorized 3-minute essay monologues. When the interviewer interrupts (which they will do frequently), rehearsed candidates lose their train of thought and panic.</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Practice conversational agility. Answer in crisp 45–75 second bursts, pausing to invite follow-up probing.</div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #2</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Failing the "Under the Hood" Test</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Listing high-level project outcomes without understanding the underlying accounting, unit economics, supply chain dependencies, or regulatory drivers.</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Perform a 360-degree forensic audit on every bullet point on your resume before interview day.</div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #3</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Defensiveness Under Cross-Examination</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Treating rapid-fire counter-questions as attacks rather than collaborative intellectual inquiries. Arguing stubbornly damages your case-method viability score.</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Welcome pushback: <em>"That's a valid counterpoint. When we modeled that risk, our sensitivity analysis showed..."</em></div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #4</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Generic HBS "Fanboy" Flattery</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Saying <em>"I want HBS because of the case method, the unmatched network, and the global alumni community."</em> AdCom already knows Harvard is great.</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Cite specific electives, laboratory centers (e.g., Rock Center for Entrepreneurship), and concrete section contributions.</div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #5</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Lack of Genuine Reflection</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Giving superficial "fake weaknesses" like <em>"I'm too much of a perfectionist"</em> or refusing to admit past strategic misjudgments.</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Share authentic failures where you miscalculated market demand or misread team dynamics, and show how you adapted.</div>
                </div>

                <div class="mistake-card">
                    <span class="mistake-tag">Pitfall #6</span>
                    <h4 class="mistake-title">Treating Post-Reflection as a Generic Thank-You</h4>
                    <p class="mistake-desc">Submitting a generic 2-paragraph note saying "Thank you for your time, I really enjoyed meeting you."</p>
                    <div class="mistake-fix"><strong>Winning Fix:</strong> Use the 24-hr reflection to add substantive nuance, correct an incomplete answer, or deepen a thread discussed during the interview.</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <h2>8. How to Practice Effectively: The 5-Step Protocol</h2>
            <p>
                Practicing for Harvard requires a fundamentally different regimen than preparing for standard MBA interviews. Follow this 5-step master protocol developed by MBA Wizards former admissions directors:
            </p>

            <div class="protocol-steps-list">
                <div class="protocol-step">
                    <h4>Step 1: The Forensic Resume & Application Interrogation</h4>
                    <p>Print your complete application (resume, essay, short answers, recommendation letters if available). For every single sentence, write down 3 potential follow-up questions: <em>"Why did you choose this method?", "What was the counter-argument?", "What metric proved success?"</em></p>
                </div>

                <div class="protocol-step">
                    <h4>Step 2: Micro & Macro Industry Synthesis</h4>
                    <p>Prepare a 2-minute master briefing on your industry's 5-year outlook: top 3 macro tailwinds, top 2 regulatory threats, primary margin drivers, and leading disruptors. Be ready to explain your company's revenue model from first principles.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="protocol-step">
                    <h4>Step 3: Rapid-Fire Interruption Drills</h4>
                    <p>Have a mock partner or AI simulator purposely cut you off 30 seconds into every response with a provocative follow-up question. Practice taking a 2-second breath, smiling, and pivoting cleanly without losing your composure.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="protocol-step">
                    <h4>Step 4: The 60-Second Answer Constraint</h4>
                    <p>Train yourself to deliver crisp, high-impact responses that land between 45 and 75 seconds. In a 30-minute interview, brevity allows AdCom to ask more questions, creating the dynamic dialogue they favor.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="protocol-step">
                    <h4>Step 5: Post-Interview Reflection Simulation</h4>
                    <p>Immediately after conducting a mock interview, set a timer for 60 minutes and draft your 350-word reflection essay. Critique what you missed, synthesize the discussion, and refine your tone to be humble, analytical, and forward-looking.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

Why MBA Interviews Matter

In elite MBA admissions, the interview is rarely a formality—it is a high-stakes stress test of your executive presence, intellectual agility, and cultural fit. Once an applicant reaches the interview stage, every candidate on paper looks qualified.

Admissions directors at top institutions use the interview to answer three make-or-break questions:
