<style>
/* ── Google Fonts ── */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap');

/* ── Root Variables ── */
:root{
  --navy:#0B1B3A;
  --navy-mid:#112244;
  --navy-light:#1A3160;
  --crimson:#B91C1C;
  --crimson-bright:#DC2626;
  --crimson-soft:#FEE2E2;
  --gold:#D4A017;
  --gold-light:#F5D87A;
  --cream:#F9F5EF;
  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --text-body:#1E2A3A;
  --text-muted:#4B5563;
  --border:#E2E8F0;
  --radius-pill:50px;
  --radius-card:16px;
  --shadow-card:0 4px 24px rgba(11,27,58,.12);
  --shadow-hover:0 12px 40px rgba(11,27,58,.22);
  --transition:.3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

/* ── Reset scoped to our wrapper ── */
.gw-blog *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
.gw-blog{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text-body);background:var(--white);line-height:1.75;font-size:17px;}
.gw-blog a{color:var(--crimson-bright);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--transition);}
.gw-blog a:hover{color:var(--navy);}

/* ── Hero Banner ── */
.gw-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-light) 50%,#1a1040 100%);padding:72px 40px 80px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.gw-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");pointer-events:none;}
.gw-hero-pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 20px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);margin-bottom:22px;}
.gw-hero h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.2rem);font-weight:900;color:var(--white);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:20px;max-width:820px;}
.gw-hero h1 span{color:var(--gold-light);}
.gw-hero-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-size:18px;max-width:640px;margin-bottom:32px;}
.gw-hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:14px;}
.gw-hero-meta span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.gw-hero-meta svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:var(--gold);}

/* ── Breadcrumb ── */
.gw-breadcrumb{background:var(--cream);padding:12px 40px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.gw-breadcrumb a{color:var(--navy-light);}
.gw-breadcrumb span{margin:0 6px;color:var(--text-muted);}

/* ── Body Layout ── */
.gw-body{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 60px;}

/* ── TOC Capsule ── */
.gw-toc{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-mid) 100%);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:32px 36px;margin:44px 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.gw-toc::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-30px;right:-30px;width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(185,28,28,.18);pointer-events:none;}
.gw-toc-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.gw-toc-header svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:var(--gold);}
.gw-toc-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);}
.gw-toc-subtitle{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);margin-top:2px;}
.gw-toc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:10px;}
.gw-toc-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--radius-pill);padding:9px 16px;transition:var(--transition);cursor:pointer;}
.gw-toc-item:hover{background:rgba(185,28,28,.3);border-color:var(--crimson);transform:translateX(4px);}
.gw-toc-num{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.gw-toc-link{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;}

/* ── Section Headings ── */
.gw-h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin:52px 0 18px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--crimson);position:relative;}
.gw-h2::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-3px;left:0;width:50px;height:3px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:2px;}
.gw-h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy-mid);margin:32px 0 12px;}
.gw-h4{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--crimson);margin:20px 0 8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;}

/* ── Prose ── */
.gw-p{margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--text-body);}
.gw-lead{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--navy-mid);font-weight:400;line-height:1.8;border-left:4px solid var(--crimson);padding-left:20px;margin:24px 0;}

/* ── Highlight Box ── */
.gw-highlight{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EFF6FF 0%,#FEF3C7 100%);border:1px solid #BFDBFE;border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:24px 28px;margin:28px 0;}
.gw-highlight strong{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;}
.gw-highlight p{margin-bottom:8px;font-size:15.5px;}

/* ── Truth Box ── */
.gw-truth{background:var(--navy);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:28px 32px;margin:32px 0;color:var(--white);}
.gw-truth .gw-truth-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;}
.gw-truth p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:400;}
.gw-truth strong{color:var(--gold-light);}

/* ── Checklist ── */
.gw-checklist{list-style:none;margin:16px 0 24px;}
.gw-checklist li{padding:8px 0 8px 34px;position:relative;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--text-body);border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border);}
.gw-checklist li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.gw-checklist li::before{content:'✓';position:absolute;left:0;width:22px;height:22px;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;top:9px;}

/* ── Bullet List ── */
.gw-list{list-style:none;margin:12px 0 20px;}
.gw-list li{padding:6px 0 6px 28px;position:relative;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--text-body);}
.gw-list li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:14px;width:10px;height:3px;background:var(--crimson);border-radius:2px;}

/* ── Daily Schedule Card ── */
.gw-schedule-card{background:var(--white);border:2px solid var(--navy);border-radius:var(--radius-card);overflow:hidden;margin:24px 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);}
.gw-schedule-header{background:var(--navy);padding:14px 24px;color:var(--white);}
.gw-schedule-header h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;margin:0;color:var(--white);}
.gw-schedule-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.gw-schedule-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.gw-schedule-time{background:var(--navy-mid);color:#fff;padding:14px 20px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.gw-schedule-task{padding:14px 20px;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;color:var(--text-body);}

/* ── Timeline Table ── */
.gw-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:20px 0 28px;}
.gw-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px;}
.gw-table thead tr{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);}
.gw-table th{padding:14px 18px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.gw-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--cream);}
.gw-table tbody tr:hover{background:#EFF6FF;transition:var(--transition);}
.gw-table td{padding:12px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:top;}
.gw-table .gw-badge{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;}
.gw-badge-high{background:#FEE2E2;color:var(--crimson);}
.gw-badge-vhigh{background:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E;}

/* ── Two-Column Grid ── */
.gw-grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin:24px 0;}
.gw-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);transition:var(--transition);border-top:4px solid var(--navy);}
.gw-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.gw-card-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
.gw-card-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:var(--gold);}
.gw-card h4{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px;}
.gw-card p,
.gw-card li{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.7;}
.gw-card .gw-list li{font-size:14px;}
.gw-card-red{border-top-color:var(--crimson);}

/* ── Day Blocks (weekly plan) ── */
.gw-week-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px;margin:24px 0;}
.gw-day-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius-card);border:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);transition:var(--transition);}
.gw-day-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);}
.gw-day-head{padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;}
.gw-day-head.navy{background:var(--navy);}
.gw-day-head.red{background:var(--crimson);}
.gw-day-head.gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy);}
.gw-day-body{padding:16px 18px;}
.gw-day-body h5{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px;}
.gw-day-body ul{list-style:none;}
.gw-day-body ul li{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-muted);padding:3px 0 3px 18px;position:relative;}
.gw-day-body ul li::before{content:'→';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--crimson);font-size:12px;}

/* ── 12-Week Planner ── */
.gw-planner-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:24px 0;}
.gw-planner-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(11,27,58,.07);border-left:4px solid var(--navy);}
.gw-planner-card:nth-child(4n+1){border-left-color:var(--navy);}
.gw-planner-card:nth-child(4n+2){border-left-color:var(--crimson);}
.gw-planner-card:nth-child(4n+3){border-left-color:var(--gold);}
.gw-planner-card:nth-child(4n+4){border-left-color:#059669;}
.gw-planner-week{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:6px;}
.gw-planner-focus{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px;}
.gw-planner-goal{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);}
.gw-planner-badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);background:var(--crimson-soft);color:var(--crimson);font-weight:600;}

    <!-- ── INTRO ── -->
    <p class="gw-p">Balancing a full-time job and GMAT preparation feels overwhelming for most applicants. Between office deadlines, meetings, commuting, and personal responsibilities, finding time to study can seem impossible.</p>

    </div>

    <p class="gw-p">Thousands of working professionals crack the GMAT every year while managing demanding jobs. The difference is not talent — it is planning.</p>
    <p class="gw-p">If you can dedicate just <strong>2 focused hours a day</strong>, you can build a strong GMAT score within 3–6 months.</p>

      <p class="gw-lead">Yes — absolutely. For most working professionals, 2 focused hours daily for 4–6 months is enough to achieve a competitive GMAT score.</p>

          </div>
        </div>

          <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">

            <p itemprop="text">Yes. Many candidates successfully prepare using official resources, mock tests, and structured self-study plans.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
          <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
            <h4 itemprop="name">How many mock tests should I take before GMAT?</h4>
            <div class="gw-faq-arrow"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg></div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
            <p itemprop="text">Ideally 6–10 full-length mocks with detailed review and error analysis after each one.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
          <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
            <h4 itemprop="name">Which GMAT section is hardest for working professionals?</h4>
            <div class="gw-faq-arrow"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg></div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
            <p itemprop="text">It varies, but many professionals struggle most with Verbal timing and Data Insights due to limited practice exposure.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

.gw-hero h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
.gw-hero h1 em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--gold);
}
.gw-hero-sub {
  font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto 32px;
}
.gw-hero-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.gw-hero-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.gw-hero-meta strong { color: var(--gold-light); }

/* ── Check list in hero intro ── */
.gw-checklist {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 28px auto 0;
  max-width: 640px;
}
.gw-checklist-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.25);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.gw-checklist-item::before { content: '✔'; font-size: 12px; }

/* ── Layout ── */
.gw-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 40px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 48px 20px 80px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

/* ── TOC Sidebar ── */
.gw-toc {
  width: 280px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: sticky;
  top: 24px;
}
.gw-toc-card {
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.gw-toc-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid));
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.gw-toc-header h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}
.gw-toc-icon { font-size: 18px; }
.gw-toc-body { padding: 16px 0; }
.gw-toc-body ol { list-style: none; counter-reset: toc; }
.gw-toc-body li { counter-increment: toc; }
.gw-toc-body a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 20px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.gw-toc-body a::before {
  content: counter(toc, decimal-leading-zero);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--gold);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.1);
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.gw-toc-body a:hover {
  color: var(--gold-light);
  border-left-color: var(--gold);
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.06);
  padding-left: 24px;
}
.gw-toc-cta {
  margin: 12px 16px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid));
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.gw-toc-cta p { font-size: 12.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
.gw-toc-cta a {
  display: block;
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-toc-cta a:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ── Main Article ── */
.gw-article { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* ── Section ── */
.gw-section { margin-bottom: 56px; scroll-margin-top: 24px; }

/* ── Section Headings ── */
.gw-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
}
.gw-h2::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -2px;
  left: 0;
  width: 60px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--crimson);
}
.gw-h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2vw, 21px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin: 28px 0 12px;
}

/* ── Paragraphs ── */
.gw-article p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.gw-article strong { color: var(--gold-light); }

/* ── Intro Box ── */
.gw-intro-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.15), rgba(15,32,64,0.5));
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,0,0,0.3);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--crimson);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 24px 28px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.gw-intro-box p { margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 16.5px; }
.gw-intro-box p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ── Info Cards (3-col) ── */
.gw-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-card {
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold);
}
.gw-card-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.gw-card h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.gw-card p { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

/* ── Table ── */
.gw-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin: 24px 0; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.gw-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.gw-table thead { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid)); }
.gw-table thead th {
  padding: 14px 18px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--white);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.gw-table tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.1); transition: var(--transition); }
.gw-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.gw-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(212,168,67,0.05); }
.gw-table td { padding: 13px 18px; font-size: 14.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
.gw-table td:first-child { font-weight: 600; color: var(--white); }
.gw-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.gw-badge-red { background: rgba(139,0,0,0.3); color: #ff8080; border: 1px solid rgba(139,0,0,0.5); }
.gw-badge-gold { background: rgba(212,168,67,0.2); color: var(--gold-light); border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.4); }
.gw-badge-green { background: rgba(0,180,100,0.15); color: #4ade80; border: 1px solid rgba(0,180,100,0.3); }
.gw-badge-blue { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: #93c5fd; border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.3); }

/* ── Highlight Box ── */
.gw-highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212,168,67,0.08), rgba(212,168,67,0.04));
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.3);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 22px 26px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-highlight-title {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* ── List styles ── */
.gw-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 14px 0 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.gw-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.gw-list li::before {
  content: '→';
  color: var(--crimson-bright);
  font-size: 14px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.gw-list-check li::before { content: '✔'; color: #4ade80; }
.gw-list-x li::before { content: '✗'; color: #f87171; }

/* ── Two-column list ── */
.gw-list-2col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 10px 24px; }

/* ── Warning Block ── */
.gw-warn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.12), rgba(139,0,0,0.06));
  border: 1px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.35);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-warn-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f87171;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.gw-warn li {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  padding: 5px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
}
.gw-warn li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.gw-warn li::before { content: '❌'; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Steps ── */
.gw-steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; margin: 24px 0; }
.gw-step {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px 22px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.gw-step:hover { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold); }
.gw-step-num {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid));
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.gw-step-content h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.gw-step-content p { font-size: 14.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }
.gw-step-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.gw-step-tag {
  font-size: 12px;
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.12);
  color: var(--gold-light);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.25);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
}

/* ── Priority Table ── */
.gw-priority-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}
.gw-priority-item {
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-priority-item:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.gw-priority-item h5 {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--white);
}
.gw-pi-vh { border-top: 3px solid #22c55e; }
.gw-pi-h  { border-top: 3px solid var(--gold); }
.gw-pi-m  { border-top: 3px solid #60a5fa; }
.gw-pi-l  { border-top: 3px solid #f87171; }
.gw-priority-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  width: fit-content;
}
.gw-pi-vh .gw-priority-label { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color: #4ade80; }
.gw-pi-h  .gw-priority-label { background: rgba(212,168,67,0.15); color: var(--gold-light); }
.gw-pi-m  .gw-priority-label { background: rgba(96,165,250,0.15); color: #93c5fd; }
.gw-pi-l  .gw-priority-label { background: rgba(248,113,113,0.15); color: #fca5a5; }

/* ── Bootcamp Table (30-day) ── */
.gw-week-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-week-card {
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-week-card:hover { border-color: var(--crimson-bright); box-shadow: var(--shadow-red); }
.gw-week-head {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid));
  padding: 10px 16px;
}
.gw-week-head h4 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); }
.gw-week-body { padding: 14px 16px; }
.gw-week-body p { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.gw-week-body strong { color: var(--gold-light); font-size: 13px; }

/* ── Mistakes Table ── */
.gw-mistakes-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-mistake-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.12), rgba(15,32,64,0.4));
  border: 1px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 18px 20px;
}
.gw-mistake-card h4 {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f87171;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.gw-mistake-card p { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

/* ── Lead Magnet ── */
.gw-lead {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-mid) 0%, #1a0a14 50%, var(--navy-mid) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.4);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 40px 36px;
  margin: 48px 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
}
.gw-lead::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--crimson), var(--gold), var(--crimson));
}
.gw-lead::after {
  content: '🎓';
  position: absolute;
  font-size: 120px;
  right: -20px;
  top: -20px;
  opacity: 0.06;
  line-height: 1;
}
.gw-lead-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 5px 16px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.gw-lead h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3.5vw, 32px);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.gw-lead h3 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--gold); }
.gw-lead > p {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.gw-lead-perks {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.gw-lead-perk {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,67,0.25);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
}
.gw-lead-perk span { color: var(--gold); font-size: 16px; }
.gw-lead-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.gw-lead-form input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 200px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 13px 18px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-lead-form input:focus { border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
.gw-lead-form input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
.gw-lead-form button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson), var(--crimson-mid));
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  padding: 13px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}
.gw-lead-form button:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson-mid), var(--crimson-bright)); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-red); }
.gw-lead-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 14px; }

/* ── Topper Secrets ── */
.gw-topper-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.gw-topper-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.gw-topper-good {
  background: rgba(34,197,94,0.06);
  border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.25);
}
.gw-topper-bad {
  background: rgba(139,0,0,0.08);
  border-color: rgba(192,57,43,0.25);
}
.gw-topper-card h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-head);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.gw-topper-good h4 { color: #4ade80; }
.gw-topper-bad h4 { color: #f87171; }
.gw-topper-card ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.gw-topper-card li {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  padding-left: 18px;
  position: relative;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.gw-topper-good li::before { content: '✓'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: #4ade80; font-weight: 700; }
.gw-topper-bad  li::before { content: '✗'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: #f87171; font-weight: 700; }

/* ── FAQ ── */
.gw-faq { margin: 24px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.gw-faq-item {
  background: var(--navy-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.gw-faq-q {
  padding: 18px 22px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  gap: 16px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.gw-faq-q:hover { background: rgba(212,168,67,0.06); }
.gw-faq-q h4 {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.gw-faq-q span {
  font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--gold);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform var(--transition);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.gw-faq-item.open .gw-faq-q span { transform: rotate(45deg); }
.gw-faq-a {
  display: none;
  padding: 0 22px 18px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  line-height: 1.7;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 16px;
}
.gw-faq-item.open .gw-faq-a { display: block; }

/* ── Final CTA ── */
.gw-final-cta {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--crimson) 0%, var(--crimson-mid) 50%, #6b0000 100%);

        <p>The highest scorers don't work harder — they work smarter. Here's the exact framework:</p>
        <div class="gw-steps">
          <div class="gw-step">
            <div class="gw-step-num">01</div>
            <div class="gw-step-content">
              <h4>Understand the Exam Pattern</h4>
              <p>Spend 2–3 days understanding the sections, scoring algorithm, question types, and timing before touching a single practice question. This foundation prevents weeks of misdirected effort.</p>
              <div class="gw-step-tags">
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Sections</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Scoring</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Question Types</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Timing</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-step">
            <div class="gw-step-num">02</div>
            <div class="gw-step-content">
              <h4>Build Core Concepts</h4>
              <p>Focus on the foundations that account for 80% of your score: Quant basics, Reading Comprehension strategy, Logical Reasoning frameworks, and Data Interpretation techniques.</p>
              <div class="gw-step-tags">
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Quant Basics</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Reading Comprehension</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Logical Reasoning</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Data Interpretation</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-step">
            <div class="gw-step-num">03</div>
            <div class="gw-step-content">
              <h4>Practice Daily Under Time Pressure</h4>
              <p>Never practice in a relaxed environment. Every set should simulate exam conditions. Use timed sets, adaptive questions, and error tracking from day one.</p>
              <div class="gw-step-tags">
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Timed Sets</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Adaptive Questions</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Error Tracking</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-step">
            <div class="gw-step-num">04</div>
            <div class="gw-step-content">
              <h4>Analyze Mock Tests Deeply</h4>
              <p>Every mock test should answer three critical questions: Why did I lose marks? Which section slowed me down? Which question types hurt my accuracy? Without this analysis, mocks are wasted opportunities.</p>
              <div class="gw-step-tags">
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Accuracy %</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Time Per Section</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Weak Patterns</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Mistake Types</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-step">
            <div class="gw-step-num">05</div>
            <div class="gw-step-content">
              <h4>Focus on High-ROI Topics in Final Weeks</h4>
              <p>In the final 3–4 weeks before your exam, narrow your focus exclusively to the highest-impact areas. Prioritize Arithmetic, Critical Reasoning, Data Insights, and Reading Comprehension above everything else.</p>
              <div class="gw-step-tags">
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Arithmetic</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Critical Reasoning</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Data Insights</span>
                <span class="gw-step-tag">Reading Comprehension</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3 class="gw-h3">Best Strategy for a High GMAT Score</h3>
        <p>The highest scorers do NOT study everything equally. They focus on:</p>
        <ul class="gw-list">
          <li>High-frequency concepts that appear repeatedly across official materials</li>
          <li>Pattern recognition — identifying question types instantly by their phrasing</li>
          <li>Decision-making speed — knowing within 30 seconds whether to invest time or move on</li>
          <li>Accuracy under pressure — maintaining 80%+ accuracy even in the final minutes</li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <div class="gw-divider"></div>

      <!-- ── Section 10: 30-Day Bootcamp ── -->
      <section class="gw-section" id="s10">
        <h2 class="gw-h2">30-Day GMAT Score Improvement Bootcamp</h2>
        <p>This intensive 30-day bootcamp is designed for students who want faster score improvement with structured daily execution.</p>

        <div class="gw-week-grid">
          <div class="gw-week-card">
            <div class="gw-week-head"><h4>Week 1</h4></div>
            <div class="gw-week-body">
              <p>Quant Fundamentals + Verbal Basics</p>
              <strong>Goal: Concept Clarity</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-week-card">
            <div class="gw-week-head"><h4>Week 2</h4></div>
            <div class="gw-week-body">
              <p>Timed Practice + Data Insights</p>
              <strong>Goal: Speed Building</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-week-card">
            <div class="gw-week-head"><h4>Week 3</h4></div>
            <div class="gw-week-body">
              <p>Critical Reasoning + Mock Tests</p>
              <strong>Goal: Accuracy Improvement</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-week-card">
            <div class="gw-week-head"><h4>Week 4</h4></div>
            <div class="gw-week-body">
              <p>Full-Length Mocks + Error Analysis</p>
              <strong>Goal: Score Optimization</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3 class="gw-h3">Daily Success Rules</h3>
        <ul class="gw-list gw-list-check">
          <li>Practice at least 2 hours daily with full, distraction-free focus</li>
          <li>Analyze every mistake immediately — don't move on without understanding why</li>
          <li>Track timing for each section in every practice session</li>
          <li>Avoid using too many resources — stick to 2–3 high-quality sources maximum</li>
          <li>Take one full-length mock every weekend under real exam conditions</li>
          <li>Focus more on weak areas instead of your favorite, comfortable topics</li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <div class="gw-divider"></div>

      <!-- ── Section 11: Topper Secrets ── -->
      <section class="gw-section" id="s11">
        <h2 class="gw-h2">Topper Secrets & Habits Checklist</h2>
        <p>This quick checklist helps GMAT aspirants avoid the biggest preparation mistakes and focus only on strategies that improve scores efficiently.</p>

        <div class="gw-topper-grid">
          <div class="gw-topper-card gw-topper-good">
            <h4>✓ Topper Habits</h4>
            <ul>
              <li>Practice under real exam timing every session</li>
              <li>Analyze every mock test deeply — not just the score</li>
              <li>Focus on weak areas weekly through structured review</li>
              <li>Track both accuracy percentage and speed together</li>
              <li>Use limited but high-quality resources</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-topper-card gw-topper-bad">
            <h4>✗ Biggest Mistakes Students Make</h4>
            <ul>
              <li>Studying without a clear strategy or weekly targets</li>
              <li>Ignoring Data Insights practice entirely</li>
              <li>Watching videos without solving questions immediately after</li>
              <li>Using too many study materials at once</li>
              <li>Skipping mock analysis — the most important step</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3 class="gw-h3">700+ Score Strategy</h3>
        <ul class="gw-list">
          <li>Master arithmetic and logical reasoning to near-perfection</li>
          <li>Improve reading speed gradually through daily RC practice</li>
          <li>Practice adaptive question sets that mirror the actual GMAT algorithm</li>
          <li>Focus on consistency over marathon study sessions</li>
          <li>Review mistakes daily — not weekly, not at the end of the month</li>
        </ul>

        <h3 class="gw-h3">Priority Focus Table</h3>
        <div class="gw-priority-grid">
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-vh">
            <h5>Mock Tests</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">Very High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-vh">
            <h5>Time Management</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">Very High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-vh">
            <h5>Mock Test Analysis</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">Very High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-vh">
            <h5>Data Insights</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">Very High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-h">
            <h5>Quant Fundamentals</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-h">
            <h5>Critical Reasoning</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-h">
            <h5>Reading Comprehension</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">High</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-priority-item gw-pi-l">
            <h5>Advanced Math</h5>
            <span class="gw-priority-label">Low</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="gw-divider"></div>

      <!-- ── Section 12: Common Mistakes ── -->
      <section class="gw-section" id="s12">
        <h2 class="gw-h2">Common GMAT Preparation Mistakes</h2>

        <div class="gw-mistakes-grid">
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 Studying Without a Schedule</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> Burnout within 6–8 weeks, with no measurable improvement in weak areas.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 Ignoring Mock Tests</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> Poor exam performance even with strong concept knowledge. Timing collapses on test day.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 Learning Too Many Resources</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> Confusion from conflicting approaches and no depth in any one methodology.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 Weak Time Management</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> Incomplete sections, rushing at the end, and avoidable silly mistakes under pressure.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 No Error Analysis</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> Repeating the same mistakes across multiple mocks with no improvement in score.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="gw-mistake-card">
            <h4>📵 Skipping Data Insights</h4>
            <p><strong>Result:</strong> A significant score drop in a section that business schools now weight heavily.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="gw-table-wrap" style="margin-top:28px;">
          <table class="gw-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Mistake</th>
                <th>Impact on Score</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr>
                <td>Studying without a schedule</td>
                <td>Burnout and stagnation</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td>Ignoring mock tests</td>
                <td>Poor exam performance</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td>Learning too many resources</td>
                <td>Confusion and inconsistency</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td>Weak time management</td>
                <td>Incomplete sections</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td>No error analysis</td>
                <td>Repeating the same mistakes</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td>Skipping Data Insights</td>
                <td>Major score drop</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="gw-divider"></div>

      <!-- ── Section 13: FAQs ── -->
      <section class="gw-section" id="s13" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/FAQPage">
        <h2 class="gw-h2">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
        <div class="gw-faq">

          <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
            <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')" role="button" tabindex="0">
              <h4 itemprop="name">What is the most important section in the GMAT?</h4>
              <span>+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
              <p itemprop="text">Quant, Verbal, and Data Insights are all important, but <strong>Data Insights is becoming increasingly critical</strong> in modern GMAT exams. Business schools want candidates who can interpret data quickly, think analytically, and make logical decisions — and this section tests all of those skills directly.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
            <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')" role="button" tabindex="0">
              <h4 itemprop="name">Is advanced mathematics required for GMAT?</h4>
              <span>+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
              <p itemprop="text"><strong>No.</strong> The GMAT mainly tests logical application of basic mathematics concepts. The exam does NOT test advanced calculus, complex trigonometry, or engineering-level mathematics. What matters is arithmetic, algebra basics, percentages, ratios, word problems, and number properties — combined with speed and logical thinking.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
            <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')" role="button" tabindex="0">
              <h4 itemprop="name">How many months are enough for GMAT preparation?</h4>
              <span>+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
              <p itemprop="text">Most students need around <strong>3–6 months</strong> depending on their current skill level. Students with strong quant backgrounds may need less time on that section, while students who haven't done formal math in years may need 5–6 months. A diagnostic test at the start of your preparation will give you a personalized timeline. Our <a href="https://www.mbawizards.co.in/how-to-start-gmat-preparation-from-2026/" style="color:var(--gold)" target="_blank">complete beginner guide</a> covers this in detail.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
            <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')" role="button" tabindex="0">
              <h4 itemprop="name">Are mock tests important for GMAT?</h4>
              <span>+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
              <p itemprop="text"><strong>Yes — mock tests are the single most important preparation tool.</strong> They are essential for timing, pressure handling, and performance analysis. Every mock should be followed by deep analysis: accuracy percentage, time spent per section, weak question patterns, and the difference between silly mistakes and conceptual gaps. Mocks without analysis are wasted practice.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="gw-faq-item" itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">
            <div class="gw-faq-q" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')" role="button" tabindex="0">
              <h4 itemprop="name">Can I prepare for GMAT without coaching?</h4>
              <span>+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="gw-faq-a" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">
              <p itemprop="text">Yes, but <strong>structured guidance can help avoid common mistakes and significantly improve efficiency.</strong> Many students spend 4–5 months preparing without coaching, only to realize they've been focusing on the wrong areas. Expert mentors can provide personalized roadmaps, mock analysis, and hold you accountable to a schedule — often cutting preparation time by 30–40%. <a href="https://www.mbawizards.co.in/gmat-coaching/" style="color:var(--gold)" target="_blank">Book a free counseling session here</a>.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="gw-divider"></div>

      <!-- ── Section 14: Conclusion ── -->
      <section class="gw-section gw-conclusion" id="s14">
        <h2>Conclusion</h2>
        <p>The GMAT syllabus is not as complicated as most students think. The real challenge is not the content — it's the approach.</p>
        <ul class="gw-list" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
          <li><strong>Smart preparation</strong> over random studying</li>
          <li><strong>Strategic practice</strong> focused on high-ROI topics</li>
          <li><strong>Time management</strong> built into every single session</li>
          <li><strong>Consistency</strong> over marathon cramming sessions</li>
        </ul>
        <p>Stop trying to study everything. <strong>Focus on what actually moves your score.</strong> That's how serious MBA aspirants crack the GMAT efficiently — and that's how you will too.</p>
        <p>Also explore: <a href="https://www.mbawizards.co.in/is-gmat-worth-it-2026-for-indian-student/" style="color:var(--gold)" target="_blank">Is GMAT Worth It in 2026 for Indian Students? →</a></p>
      </section>

      <!-- ── Final CTA ── -->
      <div class="gw-final-cta">
        <h2>Ready to Build Your GMAT Strategy with Expert Guidance?</h2>
        <p>Join thousands of students who cracked the GMAT with MBA Wizards' proven methodology.</p>
        <div class="gw-cta-buttons">
          <a href="https://www.mbawizards.co.in/gmat-coaching/" class="gw-btn-primary" target="_blank">🎓 Visit Our Counseling Center</a>
          <a href="https://www.mbawizards.co.in/gmat-preparation/" class="gw-btn-outline" target="_blank">📚 GMAT Preparation Resources</a>
          <a href="#lead-magnet" class="gw-btn-outline">📥 Download Free Blueprint</a>
        </div>
      </div>

</div><!-- /gw -->

What Are IIMs?

The Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) are a group of premier public business schools established by the Government of India. These institutes are globally recognized for their management programs and leadership development.

There are currently 21 IIM Admission 2026 in India, including top names like IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta, IIM Lucknow, and IIM Kozhikode. These institutes consistently rank among the best in Asia and globally.

Why Choose IIMs for MBA?

Getting into an IIM Admission 2026 is competitive, but with the right strategy, it's achievable. Here's the complete step-by-step admission process:

Entrance IIM Admission 2026 Exam

Appear for CAT Exam

The Common Admission Test (CAT) is the primary entrance exam for IIM Admission 2026. It is conducted once a year and tests three key areas:

  • Quantitative Ability (Quant)

Eligibility Criteria for IIMs

To apply for IIM Admission 2026, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PWD categories)
  • Final-year students are also eligible to apply
  • There is no age limit for IIM admissions
  • All disciplines — Engineering, Commerce, Arts, Science — are eligible

Communication is not just about speaking—it also includes listening, understanding, and responding effectively. Skills like data analytics, digital marketing, Excel, and business analytics are highly valued. Adding certifications to your profile can strengthen your resume and improve your chances during interviews.

      color: var(--text-muted);

    /* ===== TIMELINE ===== */
    .timeline {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0;
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .timeline::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 28px;
      top: 28px;
      bottom: 28px;

      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--blue-mid), var(--red-mid));

      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      padding-bottom: 28px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .timeline-dot {
      min-width: 56px; height: 56px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), var(--blue-mid));
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13,45,110,0.3);
      border: 3px solid var(--cream);
    }
    .timeline-item:nth-child(2) .timeline-dot { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-mid), var(--blue-light)); }
    .timeline-item:nth-child(3) .timeline-dot { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red), var(--red-mid)); }
    .timeline-content {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 20px 22px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      flex: 1;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(13,45,110,0.07);
    }
    .timeline-content h4 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .timeline-content ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
    }
    .timeline-content ul li {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-body);
      padding-left: 14px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .timeline-content ul li::before {
      content: '—';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      color: var(--red-mid);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ===== STRATEGY CARDS ===== */
    .strategy-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .strategy-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(13,45,110,0.07);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .strategy-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-blue);
    }
    .strategy-icon {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .strategy-card:nth-child(1) .strategy-icon { background: #eef3fc; }
    .strategy-card:nth-child(2) .strategy-icon { background: #fdeaea; }
    .strategy-card:nth-child(3) .strategy-icon { background: #eef3fc; }
    .strategy-card h4 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 16.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .strategy-card ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 7px;
    }
    .strategy-card ul li {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-body);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .strategy-card ul li::before {
      content: '→';
      color: var(--red-mid);
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    /* ===== MOCK TEST CALLOUT ===== */
    .mock-callout {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue) 0%, #0a1f52 60%, var(--red) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px 34px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .mock-callout::after {
      content: '✦';
      position: absolute;
      right: 28px; top: 22px;
      font-size: 50px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .mock-callout h3 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .mock-callout ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 9px;
    }
    .mock-callout ul li {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .mock-callout ul li::before {
      content: '★';
      color: #ffd700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .mock-callout .mock-tip {
      margin-top: 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-left: 3px solid #ffd700;
      border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      color: #ffe;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .mock-callout a {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 20px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .mock-callout a:hover {
      background: #ffd700;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ===== WARNING BOX ===== */
    .warning-box {
      background: #fff5f5;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(139,0,0,0.22);
      border-left: 5px solid var(--red-mid);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 22px 26px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .warning-box h4 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .warning-box ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .warning-box ul li {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: #7a0000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .warning-box ul li::before {
      content: '✗';
      color: var(--red-mid);
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ===== COLLEGES TABLE ===== */

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(155px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .college-pill {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 18px 16px;
      text-align: center;

      transition: all 0.2s;

    .college-pill:hover {

      box-shadow: var(--shadow-blue);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .college-rank {

      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--red-mid);
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: 5px;

    .college-name {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      line-height: 1.3;

    .roi-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .roi-item {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 22px 18px;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(13,45,110,0.07);

    .roi-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .roi-title {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
    }

    /* ===== INSIGHT QUOTE ===== */
    .insight-block {
      background: #eef3fc;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border-left: 5px solid var(--blue-mid);
      padding: 22px 26px;
      margin: 24px 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-style: italic;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }
    .insight-block strong { font-style: normal; color: var(--red-mid); }

    /* ===== INTERLINK BOX ===== */
    .interlink-box {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-top: 4px solid var(--blue-mid);
      padding: 24px 28px;
      margin: 36px 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-blue);
    }
    .interlink-box h4 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .interlink-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 9px;
    }
    .interlink-list li a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--blue-mid);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s, gap 0.2s;
    }
    .interlink-list li a:hover { color: var(--red-mid); gap: 13px; }
    .interlink-list li a::before {
      content: '→';
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* ===== FAQ SECTION ===== */
    .faq-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .faq-item {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(13,45,110,0.06);

      width: 100%;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .faq-question-text {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 15.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      line-height: 1.4;

    .faq-icon {
      min-width: 26px; height: 26px;
      background: #eef3fc;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--blue-mid);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 300;
      transition: all 0.25s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-icon {
      background: var(--red-mid);
      color: white;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.35s ease, padding 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-answer {
      max-height: 300px;
    }
    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 4px 22px 18px;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: var(--text-body);
      line-height: 1.75;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    /* ===== CONCLUSION ===== */
    .conclusion-block {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue) 0%, #0a1f52 55%, #4d0000 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 36px 38px;
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .conclusion-block::before {
      content: '🎓';
      font-size: 52px;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .conclusion-block h3 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .conclusion-block p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto 22px;
    }
    .conclusion-block a {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--blue);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 12px 30px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .conclusion-block a:hover {
      background: #ffd700;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ===== DIVIDER ===== */
    .cat-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--border), transparent);
      margin: 44px 0;
    }

    /* ===== BREADCRUMB ===== */

      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .breadcrumb a { color: var(--blue-mid); text-decoration: none; }
    .breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */

      .timeline::before { left: 22px; }
      .timeline-dot { min-width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 12px; }
      .toc-block { padding: 18px 18px; }
      .conclusion-block { padding: 28px 22px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 400px) {
      .pattern-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

    <div class="info-card blue-card">
      <p>One of the biggest factors that CAT 2026 Preparation Guide separates toppers from average aspirants is <strong>consistency</strong>. Many students start preparation with high motivation but lose momentum after a few weeks. CAT 2026 Preparation Guide is not a sprint; it's a marathon that requires daily effort.</p>
      <p>Even studying for 2–3 focused hours every day can bring better results than irregular long study sessions.CAT 2026 Preparation Guide Building a routine and sticking to it is the real game-changer.</p>

      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

      </div>

          <span class="faq-icon">+</span>

        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">

          <span class="faq-icon">+</span>

      <div class="faq-item">

          <span class="faq-icon">+</span>

      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
